title: ONR studies of a sixth sense
place_text: Office of Naval Research, United States

tellings.quote: going back to 2011 and 2012 the Navy the ONR specifically office of naval research was publishing studies on a six sense within humans.

plain: In 2011 and 2012 the Office of Naval Research, the Navy's research office, was publishing studies on a "sixth sense" in humans. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says so on the show, without naming the studies. If so, the Navy was spending money on the idea that people can sense things beyond the usual five senses.
